ContentLocalization.description: Configures the content localization features. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/ContentLocalization/.

CulturePickerOptions.description: Configures the 'Content Culture Picker' feature. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:ContentLocalization:CulturePickerOptions'.

CookieLifeTime.description: The lifetime in days of the cookie used to remember the culture selected with the culture picker.

OrchardCore_ContentLocalization_CultureP.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_ContentLocalization_CulturePickerOptions' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:ContentLocalization:CulturePickerOptions' instead.
